subject: Official Results of the DCCER Amendment Vote
html:
From: "Kristine Russo Diaz (Replies Not Accepted)"
Date: 2026-07-24
Time: 15-10-30
Subject: Official Results of the DCCER Amendment Vote
Dear Homeowners, 
 
Thank you to everyone who participated in the vote on the proposed amendments to our Declaration of Conditions, Covenants, Easements and Restrictions (DCCERs). We sincerely appreciate the time our homeowners took to review the proposed amendments and cast their votes.
 
We are pleased to announce that all five proposed amendments were approved by the membership.
 
Official Vote Results

Amendment 1
Article VI, Section G – Increase the capital contribution from ¼ to ½ of the current annual assessment.
Total Votes Cast: 196
Yes: 154
No: 42
Approval: 78.57% – PASSED

Amendment 2
Article VII, Section H – Increase the pet weight limit from 25 pounds to 50 pounds.
Total Votes Cast: 195
Yes: 132
No: 63
Approval: 67.69% – PASSED

Amendment 3
Article VII, Section N – Prohibit leasing within one year of a parcel purchase or transfer.
Total Votes Cast: 195
Yes: 170
No: 25
Approval: 87.18% – PASSED

Amendment 4
Article VII, Section N – Limit the number of homes that may be leased at any one time to no more than seven (7) homes.
Total Votes Cast: 195
Yes: 167
No: 28
Approval: 85.64% – PASSED

Amendment 5
Article VII, Section O – Authorize the Association to reject a purchaser or lessee for cause, including prior criminal convictions for crimes of violence or the sale and/or manufacture of a controlled substance within the past seven years, a credit score below 700, falsification of the application, a prior history of foreclosure or eviction, or circumstances that would result in an automatic violation of the Association's governing documents (such as age restrictions).
Total Votes Cast: 195
Yes: 187
No: 8
Approval: 95.90% – PASSED
 
Please note the following:
These amendments will become effective upon being recorded in the Official Records of Palm Beach County, which is expected to occur within the next few days.
Once the recording has been completed, the Second Amended and Restated Declaration of Conditions, Covenants, Easements and Restrictions (DCCERs) will be posted on the Avalon Estates website.

After the official recording, printed copies will be available for pickup in the Association office upon request.

We encourage all homeowners to replace the current Declaration and any existing amendments in your Community Documents binder with the new Second Amended and Restated Declaration of Conditions, Covenants, Easements and Restrictions once it becomes available.
 
Thank you again to everyone who participated in this important vote and for your continued commitment to Avalon Estates.
 
Sincerely,
Kristine Diaz, LCAM
Community Association Manager
Avalon Estates

We have identified two primary concerns affecting the appearance and operation of the fountains. First, there are several leaks that are causing the fountain pools to lose water and making it difficult to maintain the proper chemical levels. Second, the fountains utilize reclaimed water, which contains iron and contributes to staining and discoloration.
 
Management is currently gathering proposals to properly address the leaks and determine the best long-term treatment for the water and staining issues.
 
In the meantime, our maintenance team is working to improve the appearance of the fountains as much as possible. The fountains are being drained and cleaned, and the front surfaces will be repainted where needed. Once this work is completed, we expect the fountains to have a noticeably improved appearance while we continue working toward the more permanent repairs.

Subject: Community Updates – Clubhouse Access, Oakvista Gate, Fountains & Men’s Sauna
Dear Homeowners,
 
I wanted to provide you with a few updates regarding some ongoing items throughout the community.
 
Clubhouse & Fitness Center Access:
Good news! The main clubhouse entrance door is now fully operational and working with your key fob. We also anticipate that the breezeway entrance leading into the fitness center will be operational with key fob access by the end of the day today.
 
Please note that with the installation of the new electronic doors, there will be some changes to how the doors operate.
 
When exiting through the main clubhouse lobby, the green button that was previously used to automatically open the door will no longer do so. You may either use the handicap-accessible button, which will automatically open the door, or press the green button to release the door and then manually push the door open.
 
The breezeway doors will also operate differently. They will no longer automatically open when they sense someone approaching. Instead, a push button will need to be used to activate the doors.
 
We understand that this will be a change from what everyone is accustomed to. Once the installation is fully completed, we will send additional information, including photos showing the buttons and how to properly enter and exit through each doorway.
 
Thank you for your patience while we complete these improvements.
 
Oakvista Gate:
The card reader for the Oak Vista entrance from the shopping center is still on order. Unfortunately, we do not have a confirmed delivery date at this time, and the card reader remains out of service. We will continue to follow up and provide an update as soon as we have additional information.
 
Community Fountains:
Our fountain improvement project is still underway. Due to the significant amount of rain we have received, we have not been able to get the fountains completely dry enough to complete the work as planned. A professional company is scheduled to clean the fountains on October 2nd. In the meantime, we have made the decision to keep the entrance fountains operating rather than leave them shut down for an extended period, as we do not want to risk any potential impact to the pumps or other operating components. The fountains will be temporarily shut down as needed to accommodate the scheduled cleaning and continued work.
 
Men’s Room Sauna:
The men’s room sauna is also still out of service while we await the necessary replacement parts. Once the parts arrive and the repairs have been completed, we will let everyone know when the sauna is available for use again.
 
We appreciate everyone’s continued patience and understanding as we work through these items. While I wish I had more definitive updates to share on some of these projects, please know that we are continuing to follow up and will keep the community informed as each item is resolved.
 
Thank you,
Kristine Diaz, LCAM
Community Association Manager
Avalon Estates
